Public-URL paths for the Earth Playground texture set (served from public/experiments/earth-playground/textures/earth/). NASA-visible-earth style maps: day albedo, night city lights, ocean specular mask, bump/normal, cloud layer, star field backdrop, moon albedo + lunar displacement (LDEM). Sole declaration site — consumers import members from this frozen map rather than re-declaring the literals (zero-hardcoding rule).
